text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Industri Biobahan Api Malaysia (Peratusan Adunan dan Penggunaan Mandatori)

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 30 November 2014.

Jenis dan peratusan adunan

2. Jenis biobahan api, peratusan adunan biobahan api itu dan jenis bahan api yang

diadunkan dengan biobahan api itu adalah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual

Pertama.

Penggunaan mandatori biobahan api

3. Penggunaan biobahan api di bawah peraturan 2 adalah mandatori bagi aktiviti

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Kedua.

Pembatalan

4. Peraturan-Peraturan Industri Biobahan Api Malaysia (Peratusan Adunan dan

Penggunaan Mandatori) 2011 [P.U. (A) 203/2011] dibatalkan.

MALAYSIAN BIOFUEL INDUSTRY ACT 2007

MALAYSIAN BIOFUEL INDUSTRY

(BLENDING PERCENTAGE AND MANDATORY USE) REGULATIONS 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 4(a) and (b) of the Malaysian Biofuel

Industry Act 2007 [Act 666], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Malaysian Biofuel Industry

(Blending Percentage and Mandatory Use) Regulations 2014.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 30 November 2014.

Type and blending percentage

2. The type of biofuel, blending percentage of such biofuel and the type of fuel

blended with such biofuel are as specified in the First Schedule.

Mandatory use of biofuel

3. The use of biofuel under regulation 2 is mandatory for the activities as specified

in the Second Schedule.

Revocation

4. The Malaysian Biofuel Industry (Blending Percentage and Mandatory Use)

Regulations 2011 [P.U. (A) 203/2011] are revoked.
